summary: Adds bounded retries around the charge call. The retry loop hides a timeout as success, and the new path has no test.

findings.title: Retry loop reports a timed-out charge as successful
findings.evidence: `charge_with_retry` catches `TimeoutError` and `continue`s; after the last attempt it falls through to `return ChargeResult.ok()` without checking that any attempt completed.
findings.impact: A charge that never completed is recorded as paid, so the order ships without payment.
findings.fix: Track whether an attempt succeeded and raise or return a failure result when every attempt timed out.

findings.title: Timeout path of the retry loop is untested
findings.evidence: The only new test, `test_charge_retries_on_failure`, exercises a non-timeout failure; no test drives the `TimeoutError` branch.
findings.impact: The timeout regression in F1 would not be caught by the suite.
findings.fix: Add a test that makes every attempt time out and asserts a failure result.
findings.follow_up: Audit the other retry helpers in `src/payments/` for the same fall-through.
contextual_evidence: acceptance criterion: failed charges must never be recorded as paid
